TechnoCore Engineering (Pvt) Ltd confirms its intent to comply with the Energy Department, Government of Punjab requirements for design, supply, installation, testing and commissioning of grid-tied Solar PV systems (5 MW aggregate) across twelve public hospitals, including three (3) years O&M, training, and DISCO net-metering facilitation, as detailed in this proposal. Our prior delivery includes multiple solar energy deployments (e.g., PKR 171M completed 2024; PKR 31M completed 2024; PKR 34M completed 2020), supporting the RFP’s requirement for executed renewable projects [CAP-032][CAP-008][CAP-020]. We also evidence work delivery for federal and provincial government clients in Pakistan [CAP-042][CAP-018].

Mandatory compliance items are addressed as follows:
- Quality/eligibility: We hold ISO 9001 certification and are SECP incorporated, FBR-registered with Active Taxpayer status [CO-PROFILE].
- Bid security: We can arrange a bank guarantee/CDR from scheduled banks up to our facility limit, meeting the 2% bid security requirement [CO-PROFILE].
- Project management: We will assign a PMP-certified project manager from our pool of PMP-certified PMs [CO-PROFILE].

Gaps/closures:
SCADA central dashboard and Tier-1 modules at ≥21% with 25-year linear warranty are not yet evidenced in our library; we will close these via OEM-backed supply and warranties and by including a proven SCADA/IoT monitoring package from an established specialist partner, integrated into our delivery [CO-PROFILE]. In-house grid interconnection studies/protection coordination are also not yet evidenced; we will address this through a PE-registered electrical engineer-led team and, where required, a specialized sub-consultant to produce DISCO-ready studies [CO-PROFILE].

Administrative compliance: We will submit a 120-day bid validity, provide two sealed envelopes (“Technical Proposal” and “Financial Proposal”), include one original and two copies of each, address the submission to the Section Officer (Procurement), Energy Department, Government of Punjab, Lahore, and respond to Q1–Q7 exactly as required.
